title: File:Agrivoltaics pilot plant at Heggelbach Farm in Germany 01.webm
author: Tobi Kellner
description:
Aerial shot of the agrivoltaics pilot plant by Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems (ISE) located at Heggelbach farming community in the south of Germany.
The 194.4 kW(p) solar plant was established in 2015/16 to monitor quality and yields of a number of different agricultural crops grown underneath the solar modules. Solar modules are mounted 5 - 8 metres above ground with supports spaced in ways that allow the operation of normal farm machines.
